detailed_description: Graph Chart Generator builds an ECharts network chart from editable nodes and links. You can load sample data, edit node names, node sizes, and categories, add or remove nodes, connect source and target nodes, and choose a Force or Circular layout. Chart settings include title, color theme, label visibility, and force-layout repulsion. The preview supports pan and zoom through ECharts roam behavior, and the download buttons export the rendered chart as PNG or SVG. The tool does not include edge weights, directed-edge modes, hierarchy layouts, HTML embed export, CSV import, automatic graph analysis, or separate style controls for every individual node and edge.
usage_steps: Use Load Sample or edit the default nodes and links directly.
Set the chart title, color theme, Force or Circular layout, label visibility, and repulsion if Force is selected.
Add nodes or links, then choose each link source and target from the visible node list.
Review the ECharts preview and download the finished chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Sketch a small dependency graph for a project discussion.
Create a simple network map with categories and node sizes.
Export a relationship chart as PNG or SVG for a report or slide.

faqs.question: Which layouts are available?
faqs.answer: The layout selector offers Force and Circular layouts.

faqs.question: Can I import CSV or JSON data?
faqs.answer: No. Edit nodes and links in the visible form or load the built-in sample data.

faqs.question: Can I set per-link details?
faqs.answer: No. Links connect a source and target node, but the current UI does not expose link weight, arrow, or custom property controls.

faqs.question: Which export formats are supported?
faqs.answer: The chart preview can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.
